metadata.summary: Jitin placed a Breakfast Bundle order at Manhattan Bagel.

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
I'm looking to order a breakfast bundle.

Got it. The Breakfast Bundle includes 13 fresh-baked Manhattan Bagels, 2 tubs of cream cheese (your choice of flavors), and 4 muffins. Would you like to hear about the available customizations for the bagels, cream cheese, and muffins?
Yes.

Alright, let's start with the bagels. For the 13 bagels in your bundle, you can choose from a variety of types. Here are some popular options: Plain, Everything, Blueberry, Chocolate Chip, and Cinnamon Raisin. Would you like one of these or would you like to hear more options?
More yeah. That's it for now.
Got it.
I mean, can I can I have all 13 as everything maker?

Sure thing! All thirteen bagels in your bundle will be Everything bagels. Next, let's move on to the cream cheese. For the two tubs, you can choose from flavors like Plain, Strawberry, Scallion, Honey Almond, and Maple Raisin. Would you like one of these or more options?
Okay. Can I have, plain and strawberry?

Perfect! Your two tubs of cream cheese will be Plain and Strawberry. Now, let's move on to the muffins. For the four muffins, you can choose from options like Blueberry, Double Chocolate Chip, Cinnamon Chip, Chocolate Chip, and Cranberry Orange. Would you like one of these or more options?
I'll all I want all of them as, chocolate chips.
Got it! All four muffins in your bundle will be Chocolate Chip. Is there anything else I can get for you today, Jitin?
Are we missing a box of coffee?

You're absolutely right! The Breakfast Bundle also includes a box of coffee. For the box of coffee, you can choose from options like House Blend, Decaf, Vanilla Hazelnut, Dark Roast, or Winter Blend. Would you like one of these or more options?
Dica
Great choice! Your Breakfast Bundle will include a box of Decaf coffee. Is there anything else I can get for you, Jitin?
No.

Alright, let me confirm your order. You've selected the Breakfast Bundle with 13 Everything bagels, two tubs of Plain and Strawberry cream cheese, four Chocolate Chip muffins, and a box of Decaf coffee. Is that correct?
Yes.
Got it! Your order is all set. Thank you for choosing Manhattan Bagel, Jitin! Have a great day!
Okay. Thank you.
You're welcome! Enjoy your Breakfast Bundle, Jitin. See you soon!
Can you summarize my order?
Moving to ordering summarization stage...
Alright Jitin, I have your complete order. Would you like to hear the complete repeat?
No.

No problem, Jitin! Let me just confirm the details of your order quickly. You've ordered the Breakfast Bundle with 13 Everything bagels, two tubs of Plain and Strawberry cream cheese, four Chocolate Chip muffins, and a box of Decaf coffee. Does everything sound correct?
Yeah.
Do you have any special requests or allergies I need to note for the kitchen?
No.
Alright Jitin, ready to place this order for pickup?
Yeah.
